description: This file implements the MessageDispatcher class and its nested MessageDispatcherClient class, handling client management and event dispatching for media key sessions, license requests, renewals, and key status changes.

classes.name: MessageDispatcher::MessageDispatcherClient
classes.description: A nested class that manages individual client instances, ensuring they are added and removed from the dispatcher appropriately.

methods.name: MessageDispatcher::createClient
methods.description: Creates and returns a new MessageDispatcherClient instance for a given IMediaKeysClient.

methods.name: MessageDispatcher::addClient
methods.description: Adds a client to the dispatcher’s client set, protected by a mutex.

methods.name: MessageDispatcher::removeClient
methods.description: Removes a client from the dispatcher’s client set, protected by a mutex.

methods.name: MessageDispatcher::onLicenseRequest
methods.description: Dispatches a license request event to all registered clients.

methods.name: MessageDispatcher::onLicenseRenewal
methods.description: Dispatches a license renewal event to all registered clients.

methods.name: MessageDispatcher::onKeyStatusesChanged
methods.description: Dispatches a key status change event to all registered clients.
